title: High Tension Combo
description: 3-round HIIT with jumps and burpees, then a scissors and leg raises tabata for maximum intensity

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Depth jumps
exercises.instructions: Step down from a platform, touch the floor and jump immediately

exercises.name: Split squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, jump without switching legs

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, hands on the floor, jump feet back, push-up, jump up

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Pop squats
exercises.instructions: Jump feet apart into a squat, jump feet back together

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over and under

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, rise fully to touch your feet

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
